security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, inline filename examples, and ordinary planning language. I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration, reconnaissance intent, or executable command instructions in SKILL.md or README.md. The skill uses normal Read and Write behavior to analyze user-provided learning content and save a Markdown plan.

content.user_title: Turn Learning Content Into Shipping Plans
content.value_statement: Learning content often stays abstract and unused. This skill turns it into concrete Ship-Learn-Next reps, reflection prompts, and a saved Markdown plan.
actual_capabilities: Reads user-provided transcripts, articles, tutorials, or course notes.
Extracts actionable lessons and practiceable principles from learning material.
Frames a 4-8 week quest with a concrete success target.
Designs Rep 1 as a small deliverable that can ship in 1-7 days.
Maps future reps with one new challenge per iteration.
Saves the complete plan as a readable Markdown file.
limitations: It needs user-provided learning content to produce a grounded plan.
It does not verify external claims unless evidence is included.
It does not execute, deploy, publish, or send deliverables.
Saved filenames and deadlines should be reviewed before use.

use_cases.title: Convert a Course Into Practice
use_cases.description: Turn course notes into a first project, clear success criteria, and follow-up practice reps.

use_cases.title: Implement Founder Advice
use_cases.description: Transform an article or transcript into a market test, outreach rep, or product experiment.

use_cases.title: Create Workshop Follow-Through
use_cases.description: Convert training material into team assignments, reflection prompts, and a next-iteration plan.

prompt_templates.title: Create First Rep Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner users with one source file
prompt_templates.prompt: Read [file] and create a Ship-Learn-Next plan with Rep 1, future reps, reflection questions, and a Markdown file.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Tutorial Into Project
prompt_templates.scenario: Users who want a concrete build task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [tutorial file] to design a 4-week quest where Rep 1 ships a small working project this week.

prompt_templates.title: Reflect and Plan Rep 2
prompt_templates.scenario: Users who completed the first iteration
prompt_templates.prompt: I completed Rep 1. Use these results: [results]. Help me reflect and plan Rep 2 from the original source.

prompt_templates.title: Build Multi-Source Quest
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced users combining several learning sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [file A] and [file B], extract shared actionable principles, and create a five-rep quest with risks and decision checkpoints.

output_examples.input: A cold outreach transcript and a goal to book three discovery calls.
output_examples.output: A quest plan with Rep 1 sending 10 researched emails, success criteria, reflection questions, and follow-up reps.

output_examples.input: React course notes and a goal to build a portfolio site.
output_examples.output: A first-week portfolio deliverable, minimal learning resources, deployment criteria, and a progression path for four more reps.

output_examples.input: An article about product validation and a vague startup idea.
output_examples.output: A focused validation quest, a small market test for this week, and prompts to evaluate actual results.

best_practices: Provide the source file and a specific 4-8 week outcome.
Keep Rep 1 small enough to finish within one week.
Return after each rep with real results before planning the next one.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to create a passive study schedule.
Do not ask for a full curriculum before shipping Rep 1.
Do not skip reflection after a rep is completed.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a Ship-Learn-Next quest plan with shippable reps, success criteria, reflection questions, and a Markdown file.

faq.question: What content can I provide?
faq.answer: You can provide transcripts, articles, tutorials, course notes, or similar learning material.

faq.question: Does it summarize the whole source?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on actionable lessons that can become practice reps.

faq.question: Can it help after I finish Rep 1?
faq.answer: Yes. Share what happened, and it can guide reflection and plan the next rep.

faq.question: Does it run commands or deploy projects?
faq.answer: No. It plans work and saves Markdown output, but it does not execute or publish deliverables.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
